messages:
Jordan: quick note 9:58 PT start delayed 2m to let video team finish captions sync. moving roadmap Q&A to final 12m slot. please save deep questions for the Q&A doc.
Nina: got it. can we confirm the slide order? PMs before infra please.
Cal: infra slide is one-liner, fine to move.
Jordan: @VideoOps can you run mic/video checks at 9:59?
VideoOps: will do. DMing presenters now. checklist: mute desktop audio, use headset, captions ON.
StreamBot: Preflight OK. Recording target: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1769050000.mp4. captions: enabled. backup ingest ready.
Asha: mic/video check: "Redwood mic check"
Cal: heard loud and clear in preview.
Nina: caption preview shows ~3s lag in apac; ops watching.
OpsBot: caption TTL at apac edge ~3s. global viewers should be ~1s. monitoring metrics.
VideoOps: OBS warning: duplicate audio source detected in scene 'All-hands' at 10:03. will remove desktop audio.
Jordan: excellent. if we hit >2% dropped frames for 20s, trigger backup ingest.
StreamBot: Recording started. viewers: 18 pre.
Asha: demo starting. screen share audio low for external viewers.
Cal: raising mic gain 2dB for demo handoff.
OpsBot: marking 10:07:34-10:07:47 as low-audio segment for editor. raw+mixed audio export enabled.
Nina: small caption blackout at 10:08:12 for ~5s (apac). StreamBot, did captions failover?
StreamBot: Captions service restarted and failed over to captions-b. marker placed at 10:08:17.
Jordan: keep going, annotate the recording and we'll publish corrected transcript.
VideoOps: minor bitrate fluct at 10:09:00, dropped frames 0.08%. no failover needed.
Cal: chat Q: will dedicated support pin GPUs per-tenant? leaving for Q&A.
Jordan: answered in brief during leadership, details to be posted next week.
StreamBot: Recording stopped. Uploading to s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1769050000.mp4
OpsBot: Upload complete. Transcode 1080p + captions. edit markers and transcript will be available at https://files.redwood/recordings/1769050000. checksums good.
Nina: adding postmortem notes: caption lag APAC, low demo audio.
Jordan: thanks everyone. retro tomorrow 11am; please add action items to the board and drop follow-ups into the Q&A doc: https://redwood.app/allhands/qa-1769050000
